free_tier_limits: Free for authenticated not-for-profit use, subject to unpublished fair-use query-volume limits. Excessive use may be restricted or require a paid Spamhaus subscription; high-value contributors may receive discretionary access beyond the limits.
description: ThreatFox is a community platform operated by abuse.ch in collaboration with Spamhaus for sharing and querying malware-related IOCs. Its Auth-Key API supports recent-IOC retrieval, lookup by IOC ID or value, searches by file hash, tag, or malware family, and submission of confirmed, vetted IOCs. Free use is limited to authenticated not-for-profit use under fair-use query limits; commercial use may require a paid Spamhaus subscription.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: CORRECTED — the current terms limit free access to authenticated not-for-profit use under non-numeric query-volume limits; excess or commercial use may require paid access: https://abuse.ch/terms-of-use/. description: CORRECTED — the docs list recent, ID, IOC-value, hash, tag, and malware-family queries plus vetted submission, but no IOC-type search: https://threatfox.abuse.ch/api/. The terms identify abuse.ch as operator and Spamhaus as collaborator.
